notes:
Environmental sound pressure level measurement recorded while seated on a bench on Platform 3 at Norwood Junction railway station, while waiting for a train.

The measurement captures the everyday acoustic environment experienced by a passenger on the platform, including background station ambience, nearby rail activity, arriving and departing trains, announcements, passenger activity, and intermittent changes in sound level associated with trains moving through or around the station.

Unlike an onboard measurement, this recording documents stationary noise exposure in an active railway environment, where relatively quiet background periods can be interrupted by much louder short-duration events.

The measurement forms part of the SPL Reference real-world environmental dataset, providing a reference for comparing railway-platform noise with onboard transport, urban environments, public spaces, workplaces, and other everyday sound environments.
